# Bundled HoloSoma backend

Upstream: <https://github.com/amazon-far/holosoma> (Apache-2.0).

This source snapshot includes the HERO integration changes described in [PATCHES.md](PATCHES.md).

Upstream robot datasets, motion datasets, generated USD files, caches, and build artifacts are excluded. HERO resolves its selected G1/Dex3 assets from the release's `assets/robots/` directory.

Keep `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES`, and upstream copyright headers with redistributions.
